description: Search historical newspaper pages in the Chronicling America corpus. Returns matching pages with the opening of each page's OCR text (~500 characters), publication title, date, the states LOC indexes the title under, the page's languages, and the page URL needed for libofcongress_get_newspaper_page. Filters by keyword, date range, indexed state/province, newspaper title, and language. The excerpt is the page's first lines, not the text around the match: to read where the query occurs, call libofcongress_get_newspaper_page with the returned url field and this query as its match, which returns the passages around each occurrence; omit match for the full page text. OCR quality varies: 19th-century and degraded materials may contain fragmented or garbled text. To discover the newspaper_title, state, and language values the filters accept for a search, set include_facets to get its top newspaper_title_facets, state_facets, and language_facets.

date_end.description: End of the date filter, inclusive, in the same forms as date_start (e.g., 1920 or "1912-04-16"). A year or month ends on its last day, so "1912-04" runs through April 30. Omit to run through the current year.

date_start.description: Start of the date filter, inclusive: an integer year (e.g., 1900) or a "YYYY", "YYYY-MM", or "YYYY-MM-DD" string (e.g., "1912-04-15"); month and day may be one or two digits. A year or month starts on its first day. Omit for no lower bound.

include_facets.description: Also return newspaper_title_facets, state_facets, and language_facets: LOC's top newspaper titles, states, and languages across every matching page, with counts — values the newspaper_title, state, and language filters accept unchanged. Default false: LOC's facet block is large, so request facets when you need filter values to narrow by.

language.description: Filter by page language, named as LOC indexes it (e.g., "german", "english", "spanish"), case-insensitive. A bilingual page matches each of its languages. language_facets (include_facets) lists the languages a search covers.

limit.description: Results per page. Default 25. A page holds at most 100 results: a larger limit (up to 1000) is served as a 100-result page, and page then counts 100-result pages.

newspaper_title.description: Filter to one newspaper. Pass the newspaper_title value of a libofcongress_search_newspapers result exactly (case-insensitive), e.g., "new-york tribune (new york [n.y.]) 1866-1924" — the full catalog title with place and run. A shortened title such as "New-York Tribune" matches nothing. newspaper_title_facets (include_facets) lists the top titles for a search in this form.

query.description: Keyword search across OCR text and newspaper metadata.

sort.description: Result order: relevance (default), date (oldest first), or date_desc (newest first). Uses LOC catalog dates and upstream ordering.

state.description: Filter by LOC's State/Province facet: a full indexed name (e.g., "oklahoma", "piedmont") or a supported US postal code (e.g., "OK", "NY"), case-insensitive. Use "district of columbia" (or "DC") for Washington, D.C.; "washington" means Washington state. City and county names match nothing. state_facets (include_facets) lists the top states for a search.

name: libofcongress_search_newspapers

effectiveLimit.description: The page size actually served when limit exceeded the per-call cap of 100. Absent when limit was within the cap.

effectiveQuery.description: The keyword query as submitted to the Chronicling America API, after trimming.

effectiveSort.description: Applied LOC result order, including empty and out-of-range pages.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date`: date_start or date_end names no calendar day: a month outside 01-12, or a day past the end of its month (e.g., "1912-02-30"). `invalid_date_range`: date_start is later than date_end, or date_start is given alone and is later than the current year. `invalid_filter_value`: A state, newspaper_title, or language value has "|" between other characters, which the Library of Congress reads as a separator between filters. A "|" at either end of a value is dropped. `query_too_long`: The Library of Congress refused the search as too long (HTTP 414), which an over-long query causes. `rate_limit_exceeded`: LOC API rate limit exceeded; requests are blocked for approximately 1 hour. `server_busy`: More Library of Congress requests are queued on this server than can start within this call's time budget. `request_timed_out`: The Library of Congress did not respond within the 50-second request budget. `upstream_unavailable`: The Library of Congress could not be reached, or answered with an error status, a bot challenge or other HTML page, or an unreadable response instead of its JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next.description: True when a retrievable next page follows this one. Never promises a page past LOC's ~100,000-item retrieval ceiling.

items.description: Newspaper page results matching the search query and filters.
A single newspaper page search result.

description.description: Opening of the page's OCR text (~500 chars): the page's first lines, not the text around the match. Pass the query as match to libofcongress_get_newspaper_page for the passages around it.

languages.description: Every language LOC tags this page with (e.g., ["english", "german"]), in LOC order; a bilingual page lists each. Pass one as language to search only pages in it. Absent when LOC lists none.

newspaper_title.description: The newspaper's full catalog title with place and run (e.g., "the seattle star (seattle, wash.) 1899-1947"). Pass it unchanged as newspaper_title to search only this paper.

states.description: Every State/Province facet value LOC indexes this newspaper title under (e.g., ["georgia", "south carolina"]), in LOC order. A title indexed against its circulation area lists several, so no entry is necessarily the place of publication — libofcongress_get_newspaper_page returns place_of_publication. Absent when LOC lists none.

url.description: LOC resource URL for this page — pass to libofcongress_get_newspaper_page for its full OCR text, or with the query as match for the passages around it.

language_facets.description: LOC's top languages across every page matching this search (up to 10), most frequent first. Pass a value unchanged as the language filter to narrow the search; a count is LOC's tally and can differ from the total that filtered search reports. Present only when include_facets is true; empty when LOC lists none.

count.description: Newspaper pages LOC tallies under this language.

value.description: The language, exactly as the language filter accepts it.

newspaper_title_facets.description: LOC's top newspaper titles across every page matching this search (up to 10), most frequent first. Pass a value unchanged as the newspaper_title filter to narrow the search; a count is LOC's tally and can differ from the total that filtered search reports. Present only when include_facets is true; empty when LOC lists none.

count.description: Newspaper pages LOC tallies under this newspaper title.

value.description: The newspaper title, exactly as the newspaper_title filter accepts it.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty or a page is out of range — echoes applied filters and suggests how to broaden — plus disclosure of a capped limit or of the retrieval ceiling. Absent on ordinary result pages.

pages.description: Total retrievable pages. For result sets larger than LOC will page through (~100,000 pages) this is capped, and a notice discloses how to reach the rest (partition by date/state).

state_facets.description: LOC's top states across every page matching this search (up to 10), most frequent first. Pass a value unchanged as the state filter to narrow the search; a count is LOC's tally and can differ from the total that filtered search reports. Present only when include_facets is true; empty when LOC lists none.

count.description: Newspaper pages LOC tallies under this state.

value.description: The state, exactly as the state filter accepts it.

total.description: Total number of matching newspaper pages in the result set.

totalCount.description: Total matching newspaper pages — mirrors output.total for agent reasoning.

title: Search Historical Newspapers
